skipped.reason: Cannot reproduce Table 2 (PDF p. 16): PIT quality, treatment M=3.60, SD=0.89; control M=2.99, SD=0.86. The expert-rated PIT quality outcome is absent. The paper requires 77 ChatGPT-assisted people and 68 control people (PDF p. 11); neither arm can be identified or counted in this file. The supplied osf-rn62y SAV matches its manifest SHA-256 but contains a different dataset: 6,958 physical rows, with 240 idea records (30 labeled human and 30 from each of 7 model-source categories) alongside 6,958 pairwise-distance records. Model identifies idea sources, not human assignment to ChatGPT assistance. The ID field identifies idea records, without a verified link to c123 participants. Ocsai/CAP automated scores and pairwise distances cannot replace the paper's expert ratings. No eligible rows or exclusions can be justified, so the reproduction prerequisite fails and no participant-level contrast, SD, or SE is computed.
